name: Tomen Devices Corporation
summary: Tomen Devices Corporation engages in the sale of semiconductors and electronic components in Japan and internationally. The company offers memory products, such as flash memory, solid state drive, multi-chip package, and dynamic random-access memory; and SYSTEM LSI products, including display drive IC, CMOS image sensor, and system on a chip system on a chip. It also provides display products comprising organic light emitting diode; multi-layered ceramic capacitor, batteries, and AI accelerator. The company was incorporated in 1945 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan. Tomen Devices Corporation operates as a subsidiary of Toyota Tsusho Corporation.
